controls.name: matched_capacity_mlp
controls.description: Non-private MLP with the same architecture, optimiser family, learning rate and epoch count as the DP-SGD target recipe.

controls.name: memorising_mlp
controls.description: Deliberately over-parameterised MLP trained far longer than needed, with no dropout, weight decay or early stopping.

controls.name: unbounded_decision_tree
controls.description: Unconstrained decision tree grown to purity; the strongest memorising positive control available in this repository.
